name: Card grid
description: A grid of cards (features, services, team, linked pages) with an optional section heading and intro. A card with a link is clickable as a whole.

columns.description: Columns on wide screens; one on phones, two on tablets.

style.description: Card chrome: none, a border, or a raised surface.

align.description: Text alignment inside cards and of the header.

items.label: Cards

text.label: Text
text.description: A sentence or two under the heading.

href.label: Link
href.description: Makes the whole card a link.

linkLabel.label: Link text
linkLabel.description: The link's own text, shown under the card ("Get a quote"); without it the whole card is the link.

image.label: Image
image.description: Image on top of the card.

imageAlt.label: Image description
imageAlt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it; empty when it is decoration.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: Short line above the title (a category, a role, a price).

items.description: The cards. image is an ImageInput ({ src, alt, width?, height? }).

headingLevel.description: Level of the section heading; card titles are one below, or at this level when there is no title.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

a11y: A list of cards; the whole card is clickable through a stretched link on its title, so screen readers hear one link per card. The section is labelled by its heading.
